2: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee.
3: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion.
4: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt-sacrifice. Selah.
5: Grant thee according to thy own heart, and fulfill all thy counsel.
6: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up [our] banners: the LORD fulfill all thy petitions.
7: Now I know that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
8: Some [trust] in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
9: They are brought down and fallen: but we are raised, and stand upright.
10: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.
